channel.title: Live: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Coverage from St Mary's Stadium as Championship club Southampton look to cause a huge FA Cup upset against Premier League leaders Arsenal. Up for grabs is a place in the semi-finals at Wembley. Presented by Mark Chapman, with guests Micah Richards and Theo Walcott, who played for both clubs. Commentary by Guy Mowbray and Alan Shearer.
